title: Why Every iPhone Ad Shows 9:41 #shorts
description:
In Apple's ads and product photos, the clock almost always reads 9:41. Former iOS chief Scott Forstall explained that Apple planned its keynotes so the big reveal landed about 40 minutes in, and the screen was set to a minute or so after that. Early materials showed 9:42, but Apple soon switched to 9:41.

Question: did you ever notice this? Tell me in the comments.

Made with AI assistance (research, voice and artwork). Events are simplified for storytelling.
